elements.manual_reason: No candidate isolates the clock icon; b01 is a large diff region that also covers the new circle icon.
elements.label: Clock-with-arrow icon (moving aside)

pattern.description: The 'Speed up' clock icon and its label shrink and move to the left of the frame while a new alert icon (circle ring, then an exclamation mark rising into it) and the 'Avoid downtime' label grow in at centre-right, so the layout changes from one centred benefit to a row of benefits.
pattern.why_premium: Previous benefits shrink and stay on screen instead of being cut away, so the list of benefits builds up visually; the new icon's parts arrive in order (ring, then glyph, then label), which gives a clear reading order without a hard transition.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.benefit-1', {x: -430, y: 70, scale: 0.6, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power3.inOut'}).fromTo('.ring-2', {scale: 0}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'back.out(1.2)'}, '<0.25').fromTo('.glyph-2', {yPercent: 60, opacity: 0}, {yPercent: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.2').fromTo('.label-2', {scale: 0.7, opacity: 0}, {scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.05').
build_hint.remotion: benefit-1 transform via interpolate(frame, [s, s+54], ...) with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic); ring-2 scale = spring({frame: frame-s-15, fps, config: {damping: 14, stiffness: 120}}) (slight overshoot); glyph and label use spring({damping: 26, stiffness: 160}) staggered 6-12 frames.

notes: camera.move is none; the large scale and pan sums come from the icon group shrinking and moving left inside the frame, not a camera move. The clock icon uses a manual box. b01 is a broad diff region, used here for the ring because it is the only candidate that contains it. Whether the ring overshoots (pop) is a guess.
